propositions: Close transitions fail deterministically before LLM verifier dispatch if any non-exempt unchecked '- [ ]' checkbox appears in the AC block.
Unchecked AC items with the [operator-attested] tag (case-insensitive) are exempted from the precheck and do not block close.
The precheck reuses the shared regex matcher from det_operator_attested to ensure consistent tag matching across the two surfaces.
Non-completion close classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) bypass the AC checkbox precheck unchanged.
Prose-only AC blocks without checkbox syntax pass the precheck; only checkbox-style items are validated.
